extracted.name: Maple Cinnamon Ham Glaze
extracted.description: A simple three-ingredient glaze for your baked ham is ready for use in no time. Use this maple-cinnamon glaze to baste your holiday ham as it bakes.
instruction_lines: Stir brown sugar and cinnamon together in a bowl until well combined. Pour in maple syrup and stir until smooth.
